title: CD274 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody Western Blot Validation Protocol
author: Rosie Liu
materials: CD274 (PD-L1) Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (Cat. No. CSB-RA977797A0HU) exhibits exceptional performance in Western Blot applications, characterized by high specificity, strong sensitivity, and consistent signal intensity. The antibody reliably detects the endogenous glycosylated form of CD274 at the expected molecular weight (45 kDa) in multiple human cell lines, thereby fulfilling the objective of validating the antibody for routine CD274 detection.

steps.title: Prepare all buffers and solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions exactly as described:

substeps.instruction: 10× PBS (pH 7.4): dissolve 80 g NaCl, 2 g KCl, 14.4 g Na₂HPO₄ and 2.4 g KH₂PO₄ in 800 mL water, adjust pH to 7.4 with HCl/NaOH, bring to 1 L, autoclave, store at RT; dilute to 1× before use.
10× PBST (0.5 % Tween‑20 in 10× PBS): add 5 mL Tween‑20 to 1 L 10× PBS, mix, store at RT; working dilutions: 0.05 % PBST = 1:20, 0.1 % PBST = 1:10 with water.
Antibody dilution buffer: 2.5 % (w/v) non‑fat milk powder in 0.05 % PBST.
Blocking buffer: 5 % (w/v) non‑fat milk powder in 1× PBS (pH 7.4).
10× semi‑dry transfer buffer: dissolve 30.3 g Tris and 144 g glycine in 800 mL water, add 200 mL methanol, bring to 1 L, store at 4 °C; dilute to 1× before use.
10× SDS‑PAGE electrophoresis buffer: dissolve 30.3 g Tris, 144 g glycine and 10 g SDS in 800 mL water, bring to 1 L, store at RT; dilute to 1× before use.
Primary antibody working solution: dilute CD274 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (CSB‑RA977797A0HU) 1:1000 in antibody dilution buffer; prepare 10 mL per incubation box.
Secondary antibody working solution: dilute Peroxidase AffiniPure® Goat Anti‑Rabbit IgG (H+L) 1:50 000 in antibody dilution buffer.
HRP chemiluminescent substrate: prepare Luminol/H₂O₂ working solution according to the manufacturer’s instructions immediately before detection.

steps.title: Culture cell lines
steps.instruction: Grow HepG2, K562, A549 and HeLa cells in their respective complete media at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in a humidified incubator. Harvest adherent cells at 80‑90 % confluence and suspension cells in logarithmic growth phase.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: For adherent cells: aspirate medium, wash twice with pre‑chilled 1× PBS, add pre‑chilled RIPA lysis buffer containing protease inhibitors (1:100) and phosphatase inhibitors (1:100), scrape gently and transfer to pre‑chilled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes. For suspension cells: centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in the same RIPA buffer.

steps.title: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer
steps.instruction: Incubate the lysates on ice for 30 min, vortex gently every 10 min, then centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Clarify lysates and quantify protein
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysates again at 12 000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C to remove any remaining debris, transfer the clear supernatants to new pre‑chilled tubes, and determine protein concentration using a Bradford, BCA or Lowry assay.

steps.title: Prepare samples for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Dilute each lysate to an equal protein amount (20–40 µg per lane) in Laemmli sample buffer (contains SDS and β‑mercaptoethanol). Mix with 5× SDS‑PAGE loading buffer at a 4:1 volume ratio, heat at 95‑100 °C for 5 min, cool immediately on ice, then centrifuge briefly before loading.

steps.title: Load gels and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load equal amounts of each lysate (HepG2, K562, A549, HeLa) and a pre‑stained protein ladder into separate wells of an SDS‑PAGE gel. Fill the tank with 1× SDS‑PAGE electrophoresis buffer. Run at 80 V for ~30 min, then increase to 120 V for ~90 min or until the bromophenol blue front reaches the bottom of the gel.

steps.title: Assemble semi‑dry transfer sandwich
steps.instruction: Cut filter paper to 8.5 cm × 5.2 cm and cut a 0.45 µm PVDF membrane. Activate the PVDF membrane with methanol, then immerse it in 1× semi‑dry transfer buffer. Remove the membrane backing, place the gel on the membrane, and sandwich between three sheets of filter paper on each side. Remove all air bubbles.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Perform a semi‑dry transfer at a constant current of 60 mA per gel for 40‑60 min.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Place the PVDF membrane in blocking buffer (5 % non‑fat milk in PBS) and incubate at 25 °C for 1 h. Aspirate the blocking solution afterwards.

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of CD274 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (CSB‑RA977797A0HU) diluted 1:1000 in antibody dilution buffer to each incubation box, seal with film, and incubate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Wash membrane after primary
steps.instruction: Decant or aspirate the primary antibody solution, then wash the membrane with 10 mL of 0.1 % PBST per box for 10 min; repeat this wash 4 times, aspirating after each wash.

steps.title: Incubate with HRP secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add the secondary antibody solution (Peroxidase AffiniPure® Goat Anti‑Rabbit IgG diluted 1:50 000 in antibody dilution buffer) to the box, shake gently, and incubate at 25 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Wash membrane after secondary
steps.instruction: Repeat the wash described in step 11 (4 × 10 min with 0.1 % PBST, aspirating after each wash).

steps.title: Develop chemiluminescence
steps.instruction: Prepare the Luminol/H₂O₂ HRP chemiluminescent substrate immediately before use, apply to the membrane, and capture the signal with a chemiluminescence imaging device.

description: Specificity: The absence of non-specific bands or background smearing in any lane confirms the high specificity of the CD274 Recombinant Monoclonal Antibody (CSB-RA977797A0HU) for its target antigen. No cross-reactivity with unrelated proteins was observed.
